### AgentRoleConfig

`autotune_config::AgentRoleConfig`

```rust
struct AgentRoleConfig { /* fields */ }
```


#### Fields

- `backend: Option<String>`
- `model: Option<String>`
- `max_turns: Option<u64>`
- `reasoning_effort: Option<ReasoningEffort>`
- `max_fix_attempts: Option<u32>` — Total implementer fix-retry turns allowed per iteration when tests fail. Counts both session-continuation turns and fresh respawns. `0` disables retry (tests fail → discard immediately, legacy behavior). `None` (field absent) is treated as the default by [`AgentRoleConfig::effective_max_fix_attempts`]. Only read off the `implementation` role; ignored elsewhere.
- `max_fresh_spawns: Option<u32>` — Of the `max_fix_attempts` budget, how many may be fresh respawns (context reset, new CLI invocation on the same worktree). `0` disables fresh spawns (session-continuation only). `None` is treated as the default by [`AgentRoleConfig::effective_max_fresh_spawns`].




settings live in `.autotune.toml`.

#### Methods

```rust

```

Load from the user config path (~/.config/autotune/config.toml).
Returns empty config if the file is missing.



### TargetMetric

`autotune_config::TargetMetric`

```rust
struct TargetMetric { /* fields */ }
```

A metric threshold that acts as a stop condition.

For `direction = Maximize`, stops when the metric value is `>= value`.
For `direction = Minimize`, stops when the metric value is `<= value`.

#### Fields

- `name: String`
- `value: f64`
- `direction: Direction`

**Implements:** `Clone`, `Debug`, `Deserialize<'de>`, `Serialize`
